systems.owner: the state; the ministry in charge of civil status
systems.tiers: instituted by Article 73 as the synchronisation of the computerised civil registers of all communes, with those of diplomatic missions and consular posts; provided for in law, not reported as operating

systems.system: Traitement informatisé de l'état civil hébergé par la commune
systems.country_label: traitement informatisé des données de l'état civil
systems.owner: the commune, or failing that the departmental directorate of civil status
systems.tiers: Article 52 permits its use for drawing up civil status acts; Article 13 has the principal centres at commune seats enter and electronically archive civil status data; provided for in law, not reported as operating

note: Civil status law of 1 July 2019. It provides for electronic entry and archiving at commune civil status centres and requires data sent over the internet to be encrypted (Article 86), but a law states no connection at any commune office, so it gives no fact.
